name: dftracer_system
description: Detect the system a dftracer session runs on (systems.yaml entry from the hostname without digits: modules in order, env with ${VAR}, MPI launcher, sudo, notes), probe the PAPI counter budget, derived presets and node power, register new systems, and validate a detection result or system config deterministically. Load at stage 0 of every pipeline, on 'is not in systems.yaml', FileNotFoundError systems.yaml, wrong launcher/modules, PAPI scaled estimates or multiplexing, or site env vars missing in a subprocess.

history.why: converted from dftracer-agents register_system_tools (system_detect, system_list, system_papi_counters, system_save, moved unchanged), skill dftracer-system-detect, agent dftracer-system-detect and the system entries of the lessons; new validator dftracer_system_check
